# Reallusion releases free animation tool iClone Personal
Reallusion has released a new free edition of [iClone](https://www.reallusion.com/iclone/) , its real-time 3D animation software.

...

The new free edition was released yesterday alongside the official launch of [AI Studio](https://ai.reallusion.com/ai-studio/default.html) , Reallusion’s 3D-guided AI rendering toolset, which is integrated into it.

...

**Will support RTX Render, but only for non-commercial projects**
While you can render animations in iClone, the native real-time renderer is geared towards previews, not production work – and in iClone Personal, its output is limited to personal use.
iClone Personal will be updated to support RTX Render, Reallusion’s upcoming GPU-based photorealistic render engine, which is due in open beta in July 2026.
However, again, renders created using it will only be licensed for personal use: to use them for commercial projects, you will need a paid license.
**Comes integrated with 3D-guided AI rendering toolset AI Studio**
In related news, Reallusion has officially launched [AI Studio](https://ai.reallusion.com/ai-studio/default.html) , its 3D-guided AI rendering toolset.

...

[Read Reallusion’s blog post announcing iClone Personal and AI Studio](https://magazine.reallusion.com/2026/06/23/reallusion-unlocks-limitless-creation-iclone-personal-debuts-alongside-ai-studio-official-launch/)
